followUps.title: Add Pi-native command helpers for hook creation and validation
followUps.whyItMatters: The existing Claude setup includes a slash command and helper scripts. A Pi-native helper would make those workflows easier to discover and run in Managed Agents.
followUps.recommendedAction: Create a small, reviewed Pi extension or command workflow that exposes safe actions for analyzing hooks, showing templates, validating hook settings, and viewing hook logs.

followUps.title: Review hook security guardrails before automatic enforcement
followUps.whyItMatters: The repository documents guardrails for dangerous shell commands, sensitive files, MCP tools, and stop hooks. Turning those examples into enforcement changes how agents are allowed to act.
followUps.recommendedAction: Have a follow-up migration agent propose explicit Managed Agents guardrails and only implement the ones the owner approves.

followUps.title: Decide how to handle external integrations
followUps.whyItMatters: Some templates mention notifications, MCP tools, and environment variables. These may need secrets, account permissions, or organization-specific choices.
followUps.recommendedAction: List the integrations the owner actually wants, name the required secrets without exposing values, and implement only approved integrations.
